title: Help a visitor find the shop

scenario.en: A visitor asks you where the shop is. You heard the answer from your neighbour.
scenario.ar: زائر بيسألك الدكان فين. انت سمعت الإجابة من جارك.

source: "The shop is in Nile Street. It is next to the school and near the park. It is not far."

task.en: Tell the visitor where the shop is. Use the place words.
task.ar: قول للزائر الدكان فين. استخدم كلمات المكان.

key_points.en: It is next to the school.

model_answer.en: The shop is in Nile Street. It is next to the school, near the park.
model_answer.ar: الدكان في شارع النيل، جانب المدرسة، قريب من الحديقة.
